scorecard.key_number: all 3 other host variants redirect in 1 hop
scorecard.why: robots.txt allows all crawlers and names the sitemap; http://example.com/ 301s to https://www.example.com/ in 1 hop; https://example.com/ 301s to https://www.example.com/ in 1 hop; http://www.example.com/ 301s to https://www.example.com/ in 1 hop. The certificate is valid for 73 more days and HSTS is on.

scorecard.key_number: about 9.8% of sitemap URLs not indexed (estimate)
scorecard.why: 20 of 20 top pages are indexed and 19 declare a canonical that matches Google's choice; / has no user-declared canonical in the inspection, but its live HTML declares a self-referencing canonical (onpage_instant_pages), so Google picked the same page. Of 177 sitemap URLs, 37 had no impressions; 14 of 30 sampled were not indexed (10 'Crawled - currently not indexed', 2 'URL is unknown to Google', 1 'Discovered - currently not indexed', 1 'Redirect error').

/blog/no-show-policy/ has 85 sessions and 1900 impressions; /features/text-reminders/ has 120 sessions and 640 impressions; /lp/salon-offer/ has 410 sessions and 0 impressions. 1 redirect chain (/booking-software/ takes 2 hops) and 1 temporary redirect (/blog/2024/salon-tips/ is a 302). The other 6 retired URLs checked redirect in one 301 hop.

scorecard.key_number: 4 of 8 pages have titles over 60 characters
scorecard.why: No title or description repeats, and every page has a self-referencing canonical. /pricing/ has a 25-character title (under 30); / has a 195-character description; /about/ has two H1s; /industries/salons/ has images without alt text; the home page skips heading levels.

scorecard.key_number: 33% of the sample crawled but not indexed
scorecard.why: Every audit-set page has 300+ words. Crawled-not-indexed pages cluster in locations (8), templates (2): the city pages share one template, and /locations/denver/ has 140 words.

home LCP 2.2 s, CLS 0.02, TBT 180 ms (pass), blog post LCP 3.7 s, CLS 0.04, TBT 240 ms (warn), pricing LCP 2.6 s, CLS 0.12, TBT 150 ms (warn), industry page LCP 3.1 s, CLS 0.03, TBT 320 ms (warn), feature page LCP 2.4 s, CLS 0.01, TBT 210 ms (warn). Nothing is past a fail line. The slowest template is the blog post (/blog/reduce-no-shows/, 11800 impressions); its top resource-optimizations saving: Properly size images (Est savings of 380 KiB). TBT stands in for INP, which lab data can't measure.

scorecard.key_number: about 239 clicks at stake from 2 snippet gaps
scorecard.why: 2 live pages rank in the top 10 with a CTR under half the site median for their position. GA4 recorded 9029 Organic Search sessions against 10536 Search Console clicks (85.7%), so GA4 measures search traffic.

No broken backlinks, and no TLD outside the site's US, UK and Canada market carries a third of the links (.com 58%). The About page has 520 words and a 43-character title. Rich results found: Breadcrumbs on 18 of the top 20 pages, FAQ on 3 of the top 20 pages.
